reply.text:
Knee pain is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't assess it or tell you what it means. If it's sharp, swelling, or getting worse, get it looked at before you train on it.

I can still help with the training side. Tell me what you want to avoid on the legs for now and I'll build the upper day around that, or swap today's leg session for an upper one. Want me to make that change to your program?
